correctness.rationale: Given the quantitative ingredients cited from Pinasco-Zalduendo, the upgrade is correct. On the event \(M(Q_n)\ge a_m n^{(m+1)/2}\), the deterministic defect bound reduces \(Z_n^q\) to \(M(R_n)^q n^{-q(m+1)/2}\). The cited Gaussian union-bound tails for each r-variable block integrate to fixed-q norms \(O(n^{(r+1)/2})\); finitely many blocks give \(\|M(R_n)\|_q=O(n^{m/2})\). The bad denominator event is exponentially small and \(0\le Z_n\le1\). Thus the q-th moment is \(O(n^{-q/2})\).
